amad1_11915.eggnog_Description: A helicase nuclease that prepares dsDNA breaks (DSB) for recombinational DNA repair. Unwinds dsDNA until it encounters a Chi (crossover hotspot instigator) sequence from the 3' direction. Cuts ssDNA a few nucleotides 3' to the Chi site.
